decisions.D1_m3_reality_ws: Go aligned to bash: Reality keeps the raw primary inbound and adds ws/grpc/xhttp alongside it; M3 Go installs and is tested (no capability gap)
decisions.D2_m10_relay: Go aligned to bash: xray install --role relay installs managed Nginx stream, writes relay-stream.conf, includes it in the main conf and starts the service
decisions.D3_repeat_install: Go default adopts an existing runtime config unchanged (bash parity); --keep-config remains explicit, --rewrite-config still forces regeneration
decisions.D4_m9_listen: both sides bind 0.0.0.0 for L4 (bash menu ws-only listen prompt; Go --listen 0.0.0.0 --allow-non-loopback); loopback default guard kept
decisions.D5_m4_nginx_dir: M4 nginx directory judged from P2 manifest evidence first; change Go only if a real on-disk difference appears
decisions.expectedDiffPolicy: per-entry owner+approved_by+expires; pending counts as BLOCKER
